metadata.title: Gurtas Lefschetz Fibrations, Rational Blowdowns, and Exotic Symplectic Four-Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study negative spheres obtained from exceptional sections of Gurtas Lefschetz fibrations. Starting with the known system of $4n$ disjoint $(-1)$-sections, we show that a marked double sum contains $4n$ symplectic $(-2)$-spheres and $2n$ smooth $(-4)$-spheres obtained by pairwise tubing. By carrying the same sections through a fourfold sum, we instead obtain $4n$ disjoint symplectic $(-4)$-spheres and hence symplectic rational blowdowns. We then consider the Lefschetz fibrations on knot-surgered elliptic surfaces. Their branched-cover description gives $2n$ branch sections together with simultaneous geometric duals arising from node resolution. In the knot-surgery double these sections glue to symplectic $(-4)$-spheres, while the duals make the complement of every subcollection simply connected. The resulting rational blowdowns provide simply connected exotic symplectic four-manifolds under the parity condition stated in the main theorem. We also record the boundary-multitwist relation determined by the Gurtas sections.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 追踪 Gurtas Lefschetz 纤维化例外截面在多重和中的变化，构造辛负四球并进行有理吹降，得到指定条件下的单连通奇异辛四流形。
analysis.breakthrough: 利用同时存在的几何对偶控制补空间单连通性，使吹降构造可操作。
analysis.limitations: 双重和中的光滑负四球与四重和中的辛负四球不同；奇异辛流形结论还受主定理奇偶条件限制。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 LLM 仅协助图形准备与排版，并已核查图形；不能将这项披露说成辅助主证明。
